scripts.localhost-stop-all: npm run localhost-stop-cd; npm run localhost-stop-bridge; rm -f killCache.txt
scripts.localhost-bridge: pushd `node pkgdir.js axona-bridge`; (BRIDGE_REGION_LABEL= BRIDGE_REGION=bridge npm start &); popd; sleep 3
scripts.localhost-hosts: REGIONS=1 PER=9 PORTALS=$((REGIONS * PER)) SLEEP=$(((1 + PORTALS) * 3)); pushd `node pkgdir.js @yz-social/civildefense.io`; (BRIDGE_URL='ws://localhost:8080' npm start -- --regionsStart 80 --excludedRegions 81 84 --perRegionCount ${PER} --nPortals ${PORTALS} &); popd; sleep ${SLEEP}
scripts.localhost-start: npm run localhost-bridge; npm run localhost-hosts
scripts.localhost-oneshot: npm run localhost-start; npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-stop-all
scripts.localhost-twoshot: npm run localhost-start; npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-check && npm run localhost-stop-all
scripts.testnet-0x80: pushd node_modules/@yz-social/civildefense.io; (LAT_LNG='37,-122' BRIDGE_URL='wss://testnet.axona.net' npm start -- --nPortals 6 &); popd
scripts.mainnet-0x80: pushd node_modules/@yz-social/civildefense.io; (LAT_LNG='37,-122' BRIDGE_URL='wss://bridge.axona.net' npm start -- --nPortals 6 &); popd
scripts.testnet-check-80: LAT_LNG='40,-75' BRIDGE_URL='wss://testnet.axona.net' npm start -- --disconnectAfterPublish false --regions 80 --fireScope reuse-previous
scripts.basic-mainnet-check: EVENT_VERSION=`date -Iseconds` LAT_LNG="40,-75" BRIDGE_URL="wss://bridge.axona.net" npm start -- --subStaggerMs 200 --disconnectAfterPublish false --pauseBeforeDeleteS 10 --pauseBeforePublishS 10 --pauseAfterPublishS 20 --includeImages false --tags floodTest fireTest iceTest
